name: Talewell Memory
description: Injects the Talewell long-term memory index into the prompt, so the agent starts every turn already knowing what it knows. Companion to the talewell MCP server.

repoPath.description: Path to the Talewell memory repo.

inject.description: What to inject: a compact index (default), ranked recall for the current prompt, both, or nothing.

maxIndexEntries.description: Cap on index entries injected per turn.

recallLimit.description: Max recall hits when inject=recall or both.

cacheTtlMs.description: How long a built index is reused before re-reading the repo.
